source: User-supplied image(5).png. Copied byte-for-byte to assets/original.png.
artwork_policy: Visible rider and motorcycle retain the original pixels. Generated plates fill the removed foreground and the bike areas previously hidden by the rider.
background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean background plate for a layered animation of this exact uploaded illustration. Input image 1 is the edit target. Remove the entire motorcycle and its rider, helmet, scarf, wheels, headlamp, and contact shadow. Reconstruct the city buildings, bridge guardrail and wet reflective road that are hidden behind them. Preserve the original camera position, night skyline, blue navy lighting, city architecture, amber windows, cyan bridge lights, road perspective and hand-painted Japanese anime film rendering. Keep existing visible background features as unchanged as possible; complete the same straight bridge behind the removed foreground. The result must be the EMPTY ENVIRONMENT ONLY with no people, no motorcycle, no vehicle-shaped reflections or ghosts. Keep wide 16:9 composition and full original framing. Retain natural red/amber/cyan streak reflections in the road as ambient city light, but no recognizable bike reflection. No text, no labels, no collage, no borders. This will sit behind the exact original foreground pixels, so preserving the original projection and horizon is critical.
bike_underlay: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: occluded motorcycle reconstruction plate for a 2.5D animation. Input image1 is the exact edit target. Remove ONLY the human rider: helmet, head, yellow scarf, red jacket and arms, gloves, trousers, boots. Leave the motorcycle parked in precisely its current place and camera view. Keep the red motorcycle's exact original long shape, wheel sizes, wheels and wheel positions, tail, engine, exhaust, front lamp, windscreen, fairing panels, colors, highlights and linework. Reconstruct the motorcycle saddle, tank top, handlebars, pegs and small parts that were previously hidden by the rider. Behind the removed upperbody reconstruct the same existing city backdrop. Preserve all originally visible motorcycle and background pixels as faithfully as possible. This is not a redesign or another motorcycle: match the source motorcycle geometry and lighting exactly. Same1672×941 wide16:9 composition and framing. Do not add text, border, logos, people, extra objects, or ghost silhouettes. Keep Japanese anime film illustration style. The output is an empty motorcycle in the source scene, with no person; it will be used only for the little hidden areas revealed by rider movement.
technique: Continuous WebGL mesh animation using runtime Canvas2D masks. No AI-generated character frames are substituted.

environment_revision.ground: Projected flat road with source-derived runtime texture, procedural straight lane markings and contact-aligned perspective.
environment_revision.source_texture: Unmarked wet asphalt sampled from background.png in road-plane coordinates U[-2.55,0.10],V[2.30,3.20].
environment_revision.background_motion: Rigid city and barrier parallax with wrapped texture seams; no mirrored screen-row warping.
environment_revision.blur: Speed-driven directional exposure;33 city taps,17 barrier taps,13 projected-road taps.
environment_revision.character: Original character and motorcycle textures remain unchanged.
